about_short_description.short_description: OpenMeter offers to quickly implement usage-based pricing for AI, API, and infrastructure consumptions.

product.name: OpenMeter Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based platform for real-time, scalable usage metering and billing with API and SDK support for usage-based pricing implementation.

product.name: OpenMeter Open Source
product.description: An open-source usage metering and billing system available under Apache 2.0 license for self-hosted deployments.

product.name: No-Code Product Catalog
product.description: A flexible product catalog system that allows configuring pricing plans, credits, usage-based pricing, and entitlements without developer involvement.

product.name: Stripe Integration
product.description: A native integration that synchronizes aggregated usage data from OpenMeter to Stripe for automated usage-based billing and invoicing.

product.name: Usage Limit Enforcement and Entitlements
product.description: Features to enforce real-time usage limits, quotas, and manage customer entitlements to control consumption and costs.
